bugs_fixed.description: AutoBench 观察模式下 statusStrip 的 Phase Timing 显示全为 00:00
bugs_fixed.root_cause: monitorTask virtual task 缺少 timing 字段。后端 SuiteItem 提供 phase_timings 数组 [{phase, duration_ms}]，但前端 monitorTask computed 未映射为 statusStrip 期望的 {prepare_ms, run_ms, total_ms} 对象
bugs_fixed.fix: 在 monitorTask computed 中新增 phase_timings → timing 映射：遍历 phase_timings 数组，preparing 阶段映射到 prepare_ms，running 阶段映射到 run_ms，所有阶段累加为 total_ms

bugs_fixed.description: AutoBench 运行期间系统指标（CPU/Disk IO）始终不显示
bugs_fixed.root_cause: autobench_runner.go 的 collectItemMetrics() 方法（约第 452-467 行）硬编码 system_enabled: false 和 system_message: 'System metrics not available in AutoBench mode'。AutoBench runner 通过 BenchmarkUseCase.StartBenchmark() 直接执行压测，完全绕过 TaskBinding，不持有 SSH 连接凭据，也无法创建 SSHMetricsCollector 实例。这是后端架构限制，非前端问题。
bugs_fixed.reason: 修复需要后端架构扩展：(1) runner 需要获取目标连接的 SSH 凭据，(2) runner 需要创建并管理 SSHMetricsCollector 实例，(3) collectItemMetrics 需要集成系统指标采集。属于 Phase 2 监控扩展范畴。
bugs_fixed.next_action: 后续迭代中扩展 AutoBenchRunner 的 SSH 指标收集能力。需要设计凭据传递路径和 collector 生命周期管理。

bugs_fixed.description: AutoBench hosted tasks show no CPU/Disk IO system metrics - only TPS/TPM
bugs_fixed.root_cause: collectItemMetrics() in autobench_runner.go hardcoded system_enabled: false. Runner had no SSH collector infrastructure.
bugs_fixed.fix: Backend: added sshConfigFromConnection() to extract SSH config from connection objects; runner creates SSHMetricsCollector per item; collectItemMetrics() integrates SSH snapshot data (cpu_user/cpu_sys/cpu_iowait/cpu_steal/disk_read_bps/disk_write_bps/disk_read_latency_ms/disk_write_latency_ms); collector stopped on item completion

bugs_fixed.description: PREPARE/RUN/TOTAL always show 00:00 during AutoBench observation mode
bugs_fixed.root_cause: phase_timings[].duration_ms only recorded on phase completion, not during in-progress phase. Frontend only accumulated completed timings.
bugs_fixed.fix: Frontend monitorTask computed: added real-time elapsed calculation using nowTick - started_at for in-progress phase, with completed phases subtracted. Total = full elapsed time from task start.
